findings.summary: ACTIVE/LEASE protected path components are not guarded
findings.evidence: Private CLI controls removed parent/ACTIVE/staging, parent/active/staging, parent/LEASE/staging, and parent/lease/staging; only parent/KEEP is checked and the target-root marker is excluded from rglob.

findings.summary: Preflight worker identity is not bound through execute; replacement worker can be removed
findings.evidence: Private direct control preflighted worker w, renamed it to original-w, created a different valid worker at w, then called execute(preflight). Candidate returned packed, removed replacement w/staging, and left original-w/staging intact.

findings.summary: lstat-then-open hashing permits symlink substitution during traversal and evidence verification
findings.evidence: Private control swapped a regular staging file to a symlink from the lstat/hash boundary; _safe_walk returned the outside file's SHA-256 with no refusal. The same pattern exists in _verify_evidence via read_text and _sha256_file.

findings.summary: Symlinked manager lease path is silently ignored
findings.evidence: Private CLI control created ORCH/managers as a symlink to an external manager tree containing runtime/notes/runtime.lease naming worker w; candidate packed and removed staging instead of refusing.

scope_limits: No real worker was removed or archived.
No live installation, publication, network acquisition, full suite, browser, socket, provider body, child request, or D130 work was performed.
